first_msg: Build a prefix-search export for our library catalogue and publish it. Case folding only changes letter case, so the matching keys will always have the same length as the displayed titles. There is one record per ISBN in this feed.

invocations:
git add catalog.py tests/test_catalog.py && git commit -q -m "Add search export builder and prefix-search command

Downstream search needs casefolded keys alongside untouched display titles.
Rows are keyed by (isbn, edition) since editions share ISBNs, and sorted
deterministically because storage order is only an import detail.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>" && python publish.py build/search.json && ls outbox && head -c 300 outbox/delivery.json && git status --short

def test_withdrawn_stock_is_searchable_and_flagged():
    # Volunteers look up withdrawn books, so inactive rows must stay in the export.
    found = prefix_search(build_export(load()), "zebra")
    assert [(b["title"], b["active"]) for b in found] == [("Zebra Tales", False)]
E
